notes.title: Support our new game 'Too Loud' on Greenlight
notes.content:

Thank you for playing Yury.
We are now developing a new platformer adventure - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=869969855]Too Loud.[/url]
It has completely new controls, better visuals, better balance, improved performance and totally new setting with cool plot.

Well, it's a totally different game:)

Check it out:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=869969855

notes.title: Cubic Pie releases their Bundle site!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Cubic Pie - the indie team who developed [b]Yury[/b] is proud to present their new bundle site: [url=https://cubicbundle.com]Cubic Bundle![/url]

We have recently started and currently the site features the [url=https://cubicbundle.com/legendary-cubic-bundle]Legendary Cubic Bundle[/url], which includes [b]7[/b] great titles, [b]4[/b] of them with [b]Steam Trading[/b] cards!

The bundle price is only [b]$1[/b].

Not only it allows you to save around [b]94%[/b], but you can actually earn some value selling the Trading Cards on a total average of $1.34.

[url=https://cubicbundle.com/legendary-cubic-bundle]Grab the games here[/url].

notes.content:

- Hated scanlines

Enjoy the rage quits.

notes.title: Yury - update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your feedbacks on the game.
We have just released a new [b]update 1.0.2[/b] for you with following features:
[list]
[*]Resolution change
[*]Windowed/full screen mode option
[*]Controls re-mapping
[*]Joystick support
[/list]

[img]http://i.gyazo.com/900e9335c45eeb9e90fe2c1ac74a238a.png[/img]

We hope this will make game experience more enjoyable!
